name: Game of Hearts
source:
Casinos, villains, deadly gambling and a lots of cheating. Mystical plot with bloody gambling. Take away as much money as you can and don't let yourself be cheated. Bet your heart on the game and searching for friends or... free appetizers? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672240/Game_of_hearts/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
赌场、恶棍、致命的赌博和大量的作弊行为。神秘的阴谋与血腥的赌博。尽可能多地拿走钱，不要让自己被骗。全心投入游戏并寻找朋友还是…免费开胃菜？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672240/Game_of_hearts/]Steam[/url]]
